game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling sulfur crystals into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Sort falling sulfur crystals into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 21.
